# Resistance

# Introduction

Resistances and weaknesses determine how much damage is taken from different damage types. Creatures have innate resistances and weaknesses but are also affected by some status effects. Players may acquire resistances and weaknesses from armor, meads or status effects.

## Damage mechanics

List of resistances and weaknesses:
• Very weak: 200% damage taken
• Weak: 150% damage taken
• Slightly weak: 125% damage taken
• Neutral: 100% damage taken
• Slightly resistant: 75% damage taken
• Resistant: 50% damage taken
• Very resistant: 25% damage taken
• Immune: 0% damage taken
For players, resistances have a synergy with the armor because of the damage formula. The maximum synergy is reached when armor is at least half of the incoming raw damage which will double the resistance effect.
Similar synergy may also increase the effect of weaknesses but this requires more armor.
With the armor synergy:
• Very weak: 200%-400% damage taken
• Weak: 150%-225% damage taken.
• Resistance: 25%-50% damage taken
• Very resistant: 6.25%-25% damage taken
Example below:

• Example: An incoming attack that deals between 75-100 damage (the damage range for a creature is the top 25%) Let's assume it rolls 100 and the player has 25 armor. Without resistance effect, damage taken is 100-25=75. With resistance effect, 50% reduction is applied first, 100*0.5 = 50. Then armor is applied: (50/(25*4))*50 = 25 (for specifics: Damage mechanics) 25 is a third of 75. The resistance effect may be observed as a 66.66% damage reduction compared to not having it.

## Stacking

Multiple sources of resistances and weaknesses do not stack nor do they cancel each other out. The strongest source of resistance will override all weakness.
The selected effect is in the order of: Very Resistant > Resistant > Slightly Resistant > Immune > Very Weak > Weak > Slightly Weak > Normal
The only exception is that Serpent scale shield stacks with other sources because blocking is calculated separately.
Examples:
• Frost resistance mead (frost resist) with Wolf fur cape (frost resist) results in resist.
• Wolf fur cape (frost resist) with Wet (frost weak) results in resist.
• Lox (frost resist) with Wet (frost weak) results in resist.
• Serpent (fire immune) with Wet (fire resist) results in resist.
• Root mask (fire weak) and Root leggings (fire weak) results in weak.
• Root mask (fire weak) with Fire resistance barley wine (fire resist) results in resist.
• Tarred (fire very weak) with Fire resistance barley wine (fire resist) results in resist.
• Root mask (fire weak) with Tarred (fire very weak) results in very weak.
• Root mask (poison resist) with Poison resistance mead (poison very resist) results in very resist.

## Source for players

• Damage type: Blunt | Sources of resistance: Bonemass Power (Slightly resistant),Corpse Run (very resistant) | Sources of weakness: Berserk (Slightly weak),Vilebone Wrath (Slightly weak)

• Damage type: Slash | Sources of resistance: Bonemass Power (Slightly resistant),Corpse Run (very resistant) | Sources of weakness: Berserk (Slightly weak),Vilebone Wrath (Slightly weak)

• Damage type: Pierce | Sources of resistance: Bonemass Power (Slightly resistant),Corpse Run (very resistant), Root harnesk,Serpent scale shield (when blocking) | Sources of weakness: Berserk (Slightly weak),Vilebone Wrath (Slightly weak)

• Damage type: Frost | Sources of resistance: Fenris coat,Frost resistance mead,Lox cape,Wolf armor chest,Wolf fur cape,Moder Power,Feather cape,Asksvin cloak,Ashen cape | Sources of weakness: Wet | Other Effects: Resistance prevents the Cold Effect and the Freezing Effect

• Damage type: Fire | Sources of resistance: Fenris blessing,Fire resistance barley wine,Freezing,Wet,Fader Power | Sources of weakness: Root leggings,Root mask,Root harnesk,Tarred (very weak), Feather cape (very weak)

• Damage type: Lightning | Sources of resistance: Yagluth Power | Sources of weakness: Wet

• Damage type: Poison | Sources of resistance: Poison resistance mead (very resistant),Root mask,The Queen's Power | Other Effects: Also affects the duration (as it scales based on the damage)

## Notes

• Acquiring resistance to a fire or poison will not reduce the damage taken by a fire or poison effect inflicted before acquiring the resistance.
• Stacking fire resistance does not make you able to swim on lava like Minecraft.
